capabilities: Highlight deck words and their inflected forms and idioms with a dotted underline while writing
Show definition, phonetic, example, and pronunciation audio on hover or tap
Add selected words or the word under the cursor to the deck via button or command
Save words missing from the dictionary as drafts to finish at app.inoh.app
Cache the deck locally so highlighting works offline
extras: Freemium: works on Inoh's free plan with deck-size limits; upgrades open Stripe checkout in the browser. README includes a detailed network-use disclosure (Supabase auth, PostHog ping, no vault content uploaded) and notes auth tokens stay in device-local storage.
motivation: The author built it so learners actually use their deck words: it highlights words from your deck while you write, "so you actually use what you're learning."
problem: Obsidian offers no way to practice the vocabulary you are learning inside the notes you write every day.

relations.evidence: Apps → Connect to Claude opens the guide to practicing your deck with Claude.

requires.name: Inoh web or iOS app to build the deck
Inoh Plus/Pro plan for larger decks

summary: Vocabulary-learning companion that highlights words from your Inoh deck as you write and lets you review or add them inline.
